messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I woke up at 8am, went to class in the shitty cold rain.

output.original_text: I woke up at 8am, went to class in the shitty cold rain.
output.joy: I woke up at 8am, excited to go to class in the refreshing rain!
output.sadness: I woke up at 8am, trudging to class in the dreary cold rain.
output.fear: I woke up at 8am, worried as I headed to class in the cold, relentless rain.
output.anger: I woke up at 8am, furious about having to go to class in this miserable cold rain.
output.surprise: I woke up at 8am, astonished to find it was raining so heavily as I trudged to class!
output.disgust: I woke up at 8am, disgusted that I had to go to class in this gross, cold rain.
